body.message:
The property is listed at AED 6,000/month, all-inclusive. That covers water, electricity, and internet, so nothing extra to pay beyond the deposit.

If you saw AED 4,500 somewhere, that may have been an older listing. The current confirmed price is AED 6,000/month.

Happy to share the full listing with photos, or arrange a viewing if you'd like to see it in person!
